system.description: Through a process that deposits a thin diamond coat on a sharp surface such as a blade or arrowhead, the cutting and edge-retention abilities of an item can be enhanced. The process to apply dikote involves brief exposure of the base material to a plasma furnace, which limits the process to sufficiently durable materials like steel and ceramic. \nNote: Dikote increases the Attack Rating of a weapon or ammunition by 1, but it is limited to items that rely on a sharp edge.
